[[File:Wasaka_berry.png|thumb|A wasaka berry]]
The '''wasaka berry''' was a fruit native to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was used to create the delicacy known as [[wasaka-berry pudding]] and [[wasaka berry pie]].
